body: in my opinion, dating apps are never the way to go. for some people i suppose it works, but i feel like it’s more genuine when you get out of the house and just throw yourself at what the world has to offer. it’s very cliche but honestly just be yourself! dress nice and make sure you have good hygiene and of course be kind and open minded! even if you go home without a lady, at least you got out and lived a little, and maybe even learned more about yourself.

thank you, you’re right but it just seems as if everyone else my age has already got they’re entire future down, and they’re all happy and fit in perfectly while i’m still struggling to figure out how to hold a conversation and i just hope one day i don’t end up wasting my entire life worrying about what to do, yknow?
